release_notes:
Fix admin footer copyright not re-centering when the sidebar collapses

The 1.0.32 footer centering keyed off metronic's page-sidebar-closed class and a
225px sidebar width, but this admin's sidebar is driven by gsm-sidebar.css: it is
278px wide and collapses to a 66px rail via body.gsm-rail (not page-sidebar-closed),
and it shifts .page-content but never .footer. As a result the copyright centered
correctly when expanded but stayed put on collapse.

Footer left offset now mirrors gsm-sidebar.css's content margins exactly (278px
expanded, 66px on body.gsm-rail) with the same .18s transition, so the copyright
re-centers smoothly on expand/collapse. All of this is scoped to desktop
(min-width: 992px); mobile keeps the theme default (no footer adjustment).
